discovery.title: Self-blinking 'fairy lights' allow DNA to be imaged at almost double-helix-width resolution
discovery.summary: Researchers have developed fluorescent molecules that permit imaging of how DNA is packaged inside living cells at unprecedented resolution and, in preserved cells, at a resolution close to the width of the double helix itself.
